fields.name: cdm_etl_reference
fields.description: Version of the ETL script used. e.g. link to the Git release.

fields.name: cdm_holder
fields.description: The holder of the CDM instance.

fields.name: cdm_release_date
fields.description: The date the ETL script was completed. Typically this is after the source_release_date.

fields.name: cdm_source_abbreviation
fields.description: The abbreviation of the CDM instance.

fields.name: cdm_source_name
fields.description: The name of the CDM instance.

fields.name: cdm_version
fields.description: Version of the OMOP CDM used as string. e.g. v5.4.

fields.name: cdm_version_concept_id
fields.description: The Concept Id representing the version of the CDM. You can find all concepts that represent the CDM versions using the query: SELECT * FROM CONCEPT WHERE VOCABULARY_ID = "CDM" AND CONCEPT_CLASS = "CDM".

fields.name: source_description
fields.description: The description of the CDM instance.

fields.name: source_documentation_reference
fields.description: The reference documentation for the source database.

fields.name: source_release_date
fields.description: The date the data was extracted from the source system. In some systems that is the same as the date the ETL was run. Typically the latest even date in the source is on the source_release_date.

fields.name: vocabulary_version
fields.description: Version of the OMOP standardised vocabularies loaded. You can find the version of your Vocabulary using the query: SELECT vocabulary_version from vocabulary where vocabulary_id = "None".

fields.name: cohort_definition_id

fields.name: cohort_start_date
fields.description: The date when the Cohort Definition criteria for the Person, Provider or Visit first match.

fields.name: subject_id
fields.description: A foreign key to the subject in the cohort. These could be referring to records in the PERSON, PROVIDER, VISIT_OCCURRENCE table.

fields.name: cohort_definition_description

fields.name: cohort_definition_id

fields.name: cohort_definition_name
fields.description: A short description of the Cohort.

fields.name: cohort_definition_syntax
fields.description: Syntax or code to operationalize the Cohort definition

fields.name: cohort_initiation_date
fields.description: A date to indicate when the Cohort was initiated in the COHORT table

fields.name: definition_type_concept_id
fields.description: Type defining what kind of Cohort Definition the record represents and how the syntax may be executed

fields.name: subject_concept_id
fields.description: A foreign key to the Concept to which defines the domain of subjects that are members of the cohort (e.g., Person, Provider, Visit).

fields.name: concept_class_id
fields.description: The attribute or concept class of the Concept. Examples are

fields.name: concept_code
fields.description: The concept code represents the identifier of the Concept in the source vocabulary, such as SNOMED-CT concept IDs, RxNorm RXCUIs etc. Note that concept codes are not unique across vocabularies.

fields.name: concept_id
fields.description: A unique identifier for each Concept across all domains.

fields.name: concept_name
fields.description: An unambiguous, meaningful and descriptive name for the Concept.

fields.name: domain_id
fields.description: A foreign key to the [DOMAIN](https://github.com/OHDSI/CommonDataModel/wiki/DOMAIN) table the Concept belongs to.

fields.name: invalid_reason
fields.description: Reason the Concept was invalidated. Possible values are D (deleted), U (replaced with an update) or NULL when valid_end_date has the default value.

fields.name: standard_concept
fields.description: This flag determines where a Concept is a Standard Concept, i.e. is used in the data, a Classification Concept, or a non-standard Source Concept. The allowables values are

fields.name: valid_end_date
fields.description: The date when the Concept became invalid because it was deleted or superseded (updated) by a new concept. The default value is 31-Dec-2099, meaning, the Concept is valid until it becomes deprecated.

fields.name: valid_start_date
fields.description: The date when the Concept was first recorded. The default value is 1-Jan-1970, meaning, the Concept has no (known) date of inception.

fields.name: vocabulary_id
fields.description: A foreign key to the [VOCABULARY](https://github.com/OHDSI/CommonDataModel/wiki/VOCABULARY) table indicating from which source the Concept has been adapted.

fields.name: ancestor_concept_id
fields.description: A foreign key to the concept in the concept table for the higher-level concept that forms the ancestor in the relationship.

fields.name: descendant_concept_id
fields.description: A foreign key to the concept in the concept table for the lower-level concept that forms the descendant in the relationship.

fields.name: max_levels_of_separation
fields.description: The maximum separation in number of levels of hierarchy between ancestor and descendant concepts. This is an attribute that is used to simplify hierarchic analysis.

fields.name: min_levels_of_separation
fields.description: The minimum separation in number of levels of hierarchy between ancestor and descendant concepts. This is an attribute that is used to simplify hierarchic analysis.

fields.name: concept_class_concept_id
fields.description: A foreign key that refers to an identifier in the [CONCEPT](https://github.com/OHDSI/CommonDataModel/wiki/CONCEPT) table for the unique Concept Class the record belongs to.

fields.name: concept_class_id
fields.description: A unique key for each class.

fields.name: concept_class_name
fields.description: The name describing the Concept Class, e.g. "Clinical Finding", "Ingredient", etc.

fields.name: concept_id_1
fields.description: A foreign key to a Concept in the [CONCEPT](https://github.com/OHDSI/CommonDataModel/wiki/CONCEPT) table associated with the relationship. Relationships are directional, and this field represents the source concept designation.

fields.name: concept_id_2
fields.description: A foreign key to a Concept in the [CONCEPT](https://github.com/OHDSI/CommonDataModel/wiki/CONCEPT) table associated with the relationship. Relationships are directional, and this field represents the destination concept designation.

fields.name: invalid_reason
fields.description: Reason the relationship was invalidated. Possible values are

fields.name: relationship_id
fields.description: A unique identifier to the type or nature of the Relationship as defined in the [RELATIONSHIP](https://github.com/OHDSI/CommonDataModel/wiki/RELATIONSHIP) table.

fields.name: valid_end_date
fields.description: The date when the Concept Relationship became invalid because it was deleted or superseded (updated) by a new relationship. Default value is 31-Dec-2099.

fields.name: valid_start_date
fields.description: The date when the instance of the Concept Relationship is first recorded.

fields.name: concept_id
fields.description: A foreign key to the Concept in the CONCEPT table.

fields.name: concept_synonym_name
fields.description: The alternative name for the Concept.

fields.name: language_concept_id
fields.description: A foreign key to a Concept representing the language.

fields.name: condition_concept_id
fields.description: A foreign key that refers to a standard Condition Concept identifier in the Standardized Vocabularies.

fields.name: condition_era_end_date
fields.description: The end date for the Condition Era constructed from the individual instances of Condition Occurrences. It is the end date of the final continuously recorded instance of the Condition.

fields.name: condition_era_id
fields.description: A unique identifier for each Condition Era.

fields.name: condition_era_start_date
fields.description: The start date for the Condition Era constructed from the individual instances of Condition Occurrences. It is the start date of the very first chronologically recorded instance of the condition.

fields.name: condition_occurrence_count
fields.description: The number of individual Condition Occurrences used to construct the condition era.

fields.name: person_id
fields.description: A foreign key identifier to the Person who is experiencing the Condition during the Condition Era. The demographic details of that Person are stored in the PERSON table.

fields.name: condition_concept_id
fields.description: A foreign key that refers to a Standard Condition Concept identifier in the Standardized Vocabularies.

fields.name: condition_end_date
fields.description: The date when the instance of the Condition is considered to have ended.

fields.name: condition_end_datetime
fields.description: The date when the instance of the Condition is considered to have ended.

fields.name: condition_occurrence_id
fields.description: A unique identifier for each Condition Occurrence event.

fields.name: condition_source_concept_id
fields.description: A foreign key to a Condition Concept that refers to the code used in the source.

fields.name: condition_source_value
fields.description: The source code for the condition as it appears in the source data. This code is mapped to a standard condition concept in the Standardized Vocabularies and the original code is stored here for reference.

fields.name: condition_start_date
fields.description: The date when the instance of the Condition is recorded.

fields.name: condition_start_datetime
fields.description: The date and time when the instance of the Condition is recorded.

fields.name: condition_status_concept_id
fields.description: A foreign key to the predefined concept in the standard vocabulary reflecting the condition status

fields.name: condition_status_source_value
fields.description: The source code for the condition status as it appears in the source data.

fields.name: condition_type_concept_id
fields.description: A foreign key to the predefined Concept identifier in the Standardized Vocabularies reflecting the source data from which the condition was recorded, the level of standardization, and the type of occurrence.

fields.name: person_id
fields.description: A foreign key identifier to the Person who is experiencing the condition. The demographic details of that Person are stored in the PERSON table.

fields.name: provider_id
fields.description: A foreign key to the Provider in the PROVIDER table who was responsible for capturing (diagnosing) the Condition.

fields.name: stop_reason
fields.description: The reason that the condition was no longer present, as indicated in the source data.

fields.name: visit_detail_id
fields.description: A foreign key to the visit in the VISIT_DETAIL table during which the Condition was determined (diagnosed).

fields.name: visit_occurrence_id
fields.description: A foreign key to the visit in the VISIT_OCCURRENCE table during which the Condition was determined (diagnosed).

fields.name: amount_allowed
fields.description: The contracted amount agreed between the payer and provider.

fields.name: cost_domain_id
fields.description: The concept representing the domain of the cost event, from which the corresponding table can be inferred that contains the entity for which cost information is recorded.

fields.name: cost_event_id
fields.description: A foreign key identifier to the event (e.g. Measurement, Procedure, Visit, Drug Exposure, etc) record for which cost data are recorded.

fields.name: cost_id
fields.description: A unique identifier for each COST record.

fields.name: cost_type_concept_id
fields.description: A foreign key identifier to a concept in the CONCEPT table for the provenance or the source of the COST data: Calculated from insurance claim information, provider revenue, calculated from cost-to-charge ratio, reported from accounting database, etc.

fields.name: currency_concept_id
fields.description: A foreign key identifier to the concept representing the 3-letter code used to delineate international currencies, such as USD for US Dollar.

fields.name: drg_concept_id
fields.description: A foreign key to the predefined concept in the DRG Vocabulary reflecting the DRG for a visit.

fields.name: drg_source_value
fields.description: The 3-digit DRG source code as it appears in the source data.

fields.name: paid_by_patient
fields.description: The total amount paid by the Person as a share of the expenses.

fields.name: paid_by_payer
fields.description: The amount paid by the Payer for the goods or services.

fields.name: paid_by_primary
fields.description: The amount paid by a primary Payer through the coordination of benefits.

fields.name: paid_dispensing_fee
fields.description: The amount paid by the Payer to a pharmacy for dispensing a drug, excluding the amount paid for the drug ingredient. paid_dispensing_fee contributes to the paid_by_payer field if this field is populated with a nonzero value.

fields.name: paid_ingredient_cost
fields.description: The amount paid by the Payer to a pharmacy for the drug, excluding the amount paid for dispensing the drug. paid_ingredient_cost contributes to the paid_by_payer field if this field is populated with a nonzero value.

fields.name: paid_patient_coinsurance
fields.description: The amount paid by the Person as a joint assumption of risk. Typically, this is a percentage of the expenses defined by the Payer Plan after the Person

fields.name: paid_patient_copay
fields.description: The amount paid by the Person as a fixed contribution to the expenses.

fields.name: paid_patient_deductible
fields.description: The amount paid by the Person that is counted toward the deductible defined by the Payer Plan. paid_patient_deductible does contribute to the paid_by_patient variable.

fields.name: payer_plan_period_id
fields.description: A foreign key to the PAYER_PLAN_PERIOD table, where the details of the Payer, Plan and Family are stored. Record the payer_plan_id that relates to the payer who contributed to the paid_by_payer field.

fields.name: revenue_code_concept_id
fields.description: A foreign key referring to a Standard Concept ID in the Standardized Vocabularies for Revenue codes.

fields.name: revenue_code_source_value
fields.description: The source code for the Revenue code as it appears in the source data, stored here for reference.

fields.name: total_charge
fields.description: The total amount charged by some provider of goods or services (e.g. hospital, physician pharmacy, dme provider) to payers (insurance companies, the patient).

fields.name: total_cost
fields.description: The cost incurred by the provider of goods or services.

fields.name: total_paid
fields.description: The total amount actually paid from all payers for goods or services of the provider.

fields.name: cause_concept_id
fields.description: A foreign key referring to a standard concept identifier in the Standardized Vocabularies for conditions.

fields.name: cause_source_concept_id
fields.description: A foreign key to the concept that refers to the code used in the source. Note, this variable name is abbreviated to ensure it will be allowable across database platforms.

fields.name: cause_source_value
fields.description: The source code for the cause of death as it appears in the source data. This code is mapped to a standard concept in the Standardized Vocabularies and the original code is, stored here for reference.

fields.name: death_date
fields.description: The date the person was deceased. If the precise date including day or month is not known or not allowed, December is used as the default month, and the last day of the month the default day.

fields.name: death_datetime
fields.description: The date and time the person was deceased. If the precise date including day or month is not known or not allowed, December is used as the default month, and the last day of the month the default day.

fields.name: death_type_concept_id
fields.description: A foreign key referring to the predefined concept identifier in the Standardized Vocabularies reflecting how the death was represented in the source data.

fields.name: person_id
fields.description: A foreign key identifier to the deceased person. The demographic details of that person are stored in the person table.

fields.name: device_concept_id
fields.description: A foreign key that refers to a Standard Concept identifier in the Standardized Vocabularies for the Device concept.

fields.name: device_exposure_end_date
fields.description: The date the Device or supply was removed from use.

fields.name: device_exposure_end_datetime
fields.description: The date and time the Device or supply was removed from use.

fields.name: device_exposure_id
fields.description: A system-generated unique identifier for each Device Exposure.

fields.name: device_exposure_start_date
fields.description: The date the Device or supply was applied or used.

fields.name: device_exposure_start_datetime
fields.description: The date and time the Device or supply was applied or used.

fields.name: device_source_concept_id
fields.description: A foreign key to a Device Concept that refers to the code used in the source.

fields.name: device_source_value
fields.description: The source code for the Device as it appears in the source data. This code is mapped to a standard Device Concept in the Standardized Vocabularies and the original code is stored here for reference.

fields.name: device_type_concept_id
fields.description: A foreign key to the predefined Concept identifier in the Standardized Vocabularies reflecting the type of Device Exposure recorded. It indicates how the Device Exposure was represented in the source data.

fields.name: person_id
fields.description: A foreign key identifier to the Person who is subjected to the Device. The demographic details of that person are stored in the Person table.

fields.name: production_id
fields.description: This is the Production Identifier (UDI-PI) portion of the Unique Device Identification.

fields.name: provider_id
fields.description: A foreign key to the provider in the PROVIDER table who initiated of administered the Device.

fields.name: quantity
fields.description: The number of individual Devices used for the exposure.

fields.name: unique_device_id
fields.description: A UDI or equivalent identifying the instance of the Device used in the Person.

fields.name: unit_concept_id
fields.description: UNIT_SOURCE_VALUES should be mapped to a Standard Concept in the Unit domain that best represents the unit as given in the source data.

fields.name: unit_source_concept_id
fields.description: This is the concept representing the UNIT_SOURCE_VALUE and may not necessarily be standard. This field is discouraged from use in analysis because it is not required to contain Standard Concepts that are used across the OHDSI community, and should only be used when Standard Concepts do not adequately represent the source detail for the Unit necessary for a given analytic use case. Consider using UNIT_CONCEPT_ID instead to enable standardized analytics that can be consistent across the network.

fields.name: unit_source_value
fields.description: This field houses the verbatim value from the source data representing the unit of the Device. For example, blood transfusions are considered devices and can be given in mL quantities.

fields.name: visit_detail_id
fields.description: A foreign key to the visit in the visit-detail table during which the Drug Exposure was initiated.

fields.name: visit_occurrence_id
fields.description: A foreign key to the visit in the VISIT table during which the device was used.

fields.name: domain_concept_id
fields.description: A foreign key that refers to an identifier in the [CONCEPT](https://github.com/OHDSI/CommonDataModel/wiki/CONCEPT) table for the unique Domain Concept the Domain record belongs to.

fields.name: domain_id
fields.description: A unique key for each domain.

fields.name: domain_name
fields.description: The name describing the Domain, e.g. "Condition", "Procedure", "Measurement" etc.

fields.name: dose_era_end_date
fields.description: The end date for the drug era constructed from the individual instance of drug exposures. It is the end date of the final continuously recorded instance of utilization of a drug.

fields.name: dose_era_id
fields.description: A unique identifier for each Dose Era.

fields.name: dose_era_start_date
fields.description: The start date for the drug era constructed from the individual instances of drug exposures. It is the start date of the very first chronologically recorded instance of utilization of a drug.

fields.name: dose_value
fields.description: The numeric value of the dose.

fields.name: drug_concept_id
fields.description: A foreign key that refers to a Standard Concept identifier in the Standardized Vocabularies for the active Ingredient Concept.

fields.name: person_id
fields.description: A foreign key identifier to the Person who is subjected to the drug during the drug era. The demographic details of that Person are stored in the PERSON table.

fields.name: unit_concept_id
fields.description: A foreign key that refers to a Standard Concept identifier in the Standardized Vocabularies for the unit concept.

fields.name: drug_concept_id
fields.description: A foreign key that refers to a Standard Concept identifier in the Standardized Vocabularies for the Ingredient Concept.

fields.name: drug_era_end_date
fields.description: The end date for the drug era constructed from the individual instance of drug exposures. It is the end date of the final continuously recorded instance of utilization of a drug.

fields.name: drug_era_id
fields.description: A unique identifier for each Drug Era.

fields.name: drug_era_start_date
fields.description: The start date for the Drug Era constructed from the individual instances of Drug Exposures. It is the start date of the very first chronologically recorded instance of conutilization of a Drug.

fields.name: drug_exposure_count

fields.name: drug_source_concept_id

fields.name: drug_type_concept_id

fields.name: lot_number

fields.name: invalid_reason
fields.description: Reason the concept was invalidated. Possible values are

fields.name: numerator_unit_concept_id

fields.name: numerator_value
fields.description: The numeric value associated with the concentration of the active ingredient contained in the product

fields.name: valid_start_date

fields.name: episode_concept_id

fields.name: episode_end_date

fields.name: episode_end_datetime
fields.description: The date and time when the instance of the Episode is considered to have ended.

fields.name: episode_id
fields.description: A unique identifier for each Episode.

fields.name: episode_number
fields.description: For sequences of episodes, this is used to indicate the order the episodes occurred. For example, lines of treatment could be indicated here. Please see [article] for the details of how to count episodes.

fields.name: episode_object_concept_id
fields.description: A Standard Concept representing the disease phase, outcome, or other abstraction of which the episode consists. For example, if the EPISODE_CONCEPT_ID is treatment regimen then the EPISODE_OBJECT_CONCEPT_ID should contain the chemotherapy regimen concept, like Afatinib monotherapy.

fields.name: episode_parent_id
fields.description: Use this field to find the Episode that subsumes the given Episode record. This is used in the case that Episodes are nested into each other.

fields.name: episode_source_concept_id
fields.description: A foreign key to an Episode Concept that refers to the code used in the source. Given that the Episodes are user-defined it is unlikely that there will be a Source Concept available. If that is the case then set this field to zero.

fields.name: episode_source_value

fields.name: episode_start_date

fields.name: episode_start_datetime
fields.description: The date and time when the Episode begins.

fields.name: episode_type_concept_id
fields.description: This field can be used to determine the provenance of the Episode record, as in whether the episode was from an EHR system, insurance claim, registry, or other sources. Choose the EPISODE_TYPE_CONCEPT_ID that best represents the provenance of the record.

fields.name: person_id
fields.description: The PERSON_ID of the PERSON for whom the episode is recorded.

fields.name: episode_event_field_concept_id
fields.description: This field is the CONCEPT_ID that identifies which table the primary key of the linked record came from. Put the CONCEPT_ID that identifies which table and field the EVENT_ID came from. Accepted Concepts.

fields.name: episode_id

fields.name: event_id

fields.name: domain_concept_id_1

fields.name: domain_concept_id_2

fields.name: fact_id_1

fields.name: fact_id_2

fields.name: relationship_concept_id

fields.name: address_1

fields.name: address_2

fields.name: city
fields.description: The city field as it appears in the source data.

fields.name: country_concept_id
fields.description: The Concept Id representing the country. Values should conform to the Geography domain.

fields.name: country_source_value
fields.description: The name of the country.

fields.name: county
fields.description: The county.

fields.name: latitude
fields.description: Must be between -90 and 90.

fields.name: location_id
fields.description: A unique identifier for each geographic location.

fields.name: location_source_value
fields.description: The verbatim information that is used to uniquely identify the location as it appears in the source data.

fields.name: longitude
fields.description: Must be between -180 and 180.

fields.name: state
fields.description: The state field as it appears in the source data.

fields.name: zip
fields.description: The zip or postal code.

fields.name: meas_event_field_concept_id
fields.description: If the Measurement record is related to another record in the database, this field is the CONCEPT_ID that identifies which table the primary key of the linked record came from.

fields.name: measurement_concept_id

fields.name: measurement_date

fields.name: measurement_datetime
fields.description: The date and time of the Measurement. Some database systems don

fields.name: measurement_event_id

fields.name: measurement_id

fields.name: measurement_source_concept_id
fields.description: A foreign key to a Concept in the Standard Vocabularies that refers to the code used in the source.

fields.name: measurement_source_value
fields.description: The Measurement name as it appears in the source data. This code is mapped to a Standard Concept in the Standardized Vocabularies and the original code is stored here for reference.

fields.name: measurement_time
fields.description: This is present for backwards compatibility and will be deprecated in an upcoming version.

fields.name: measurement_type_concept_id
fields.description: A foreign key to the predefined Concept in the Standardized Vocabularies reflecting the provenance from where the Measurement record was recorded.

fields.name: operator_concept_id
fields.description: A foreign key identifier to the predefined Concept in the Standardized Vocabularies reflecting the mathematical operator that is applied to the value_as_number. Operators are <, <=, =, >=, >.

fields.name: person_id
fields.description: A foreign key identifier to the Person about whom the measurement was recorded. The demographic details of that Person are stored in the PERSON table.

fields.name: provider_id

fields.name: range_high
fields.description: The upper limit of the normal range of the Measurement. The upper range is assumed to be of the same unit of measure as the Measurement value.

fields.name: range_low
fields.description: The lower limit of the normal range of the Measurement result. The lower range is assumed to be of the same unit of measure as the Measurement value.

fields.name: unit_concept_id
fields.description: A foreign key to a Standard Concept ID of Measurement Units in the Standardized Vocabularies.

fields.name: unit_source_concept_id
fields.description: This is the concept representing the UNIT_SOURCE_VALUE and may not necessarily be standard. This field is discouraged from use in analysis because it is not required to contain Standard Concepts that are used across the OHDSI community, and should only be used when Standard Concepts do not adequately represent the source detail for the Measurement necessary for a given analytic use case. Consider using UNIT_CONCEPT_ID instead to enable standardized analytics that can be consistent across the network.

fields.name: unit_source_value

fields.name: value_as_concept_id

fields.name: value_as_number

fields.name: value_source_value

fields.name: visit_detail_id

fields.name: visit_occurrence_id
fields.description: A foreign key to the Visit in the VISIT_OCCURRENCE table during which the Measurement was recorded.

Term_modifiers will concatenate all modifiers for different types of entities (conditions, drugs, labs etc) into one string. Lab values will be saved as one of the modifiers

fields.description: If the Observation record is related to another record in the database, this field is the primary key of the linked record.

fields.name: observation_id

fields.name: observation_source_concept_id
fields.description: A foreign key to a Concept that refers to the code used in the source.

fields.name: observation_source_value
fields.description: The observation code as it appears in the source data. This code is mapped to a Standard Concept in the Standardized Vocabularies and the original code is, stored here for reference.

fields.description: A foreign key to the predefined concept identifier in the Standardized Vocabularies reflecting the type of the observation.

fields.name: visit_detail_id
fields.description: A foreign key to the visit in the VISIT_DETAIL table during which the observation was recorded.

fields.name: visit_occurrence_id
fields.description: A foreign key to the visit in the VISIT_OCCURRENCE table during which the observation was recorded.

fields.name: race_source_value
